cv.name: Mitchell Tran
cv.headline: Data Analyst – Retail & Customer Analytics
cv.summary: Data analyst with three years in retail and customer analytics. I build reliable SQL models and dashboards that store and category managers actually use, and enjoy digging into why a number moved.

experience.title: Data Analyst
bullets: Own weekly sales and promotions dashboards in Tableau for 64 stores
Built a basket-analysis model in SQL and Python that informed a range review across three categories
Automated the monthly loyalty report, saving the team around two days per month
Work with category managers to define KPIs and clean up conflicting metric definitions

experience.title: Junior Data Analyst
bullets: Analysed churn drivers for residential customers using survey and billing data
Maintained data quality checks on the customer data warehouse
